title: 3dpc.b: sos_post accounting keyed by full 16-byte origin address; drop alert_node_iid
description: Child of 3dpc, after 3dpc.a. Spec 18.4.1: the SOS rate-limit/seq accounting key is the full 16-byte origin IPv6 address (MUST NOT extract an IID); 18.4.2 node field is the full 0200:: address string. In coap_server.c sos_post: (1) parse alert->node (8 colon groups, already validated by validate_node_id) into 16 bytes; (2) reject unless AddrForKey(key_entry.pubkey) == parsed address (string is attacker-supplied; the binding must come from the verified pubkey); (3) key lichen_key_store lookup via lichen_key_store_get_by_addr (3dpc.a) instead of alert_node_iid; (4) re-key s_sos_origins entries from iid[8] to addr[16] (shared header + host test update); (5) delete alert_node_iid. Update lichen/tests/sos_origin_table. C<->Python: codec already accepts the spec colon form; Python emits 16-hex (3dpc.c), so wire interop stays broken until .c lands - unchanged breakage, not a regression. Verify: native_sim build coap_config_put_auth + host ctest.
